lyrics:
[Intro: electric piano, finger snaps, harmonised oohs]

[Verse 1: silky male tenor]
Got a highlight reel and a good left side
Got a laugh I do when I'm trying to hide
Three hundred people think they know my name
None of them have seen me when I'm off my game

[Pre-Chorus: harmonies stacking]
There's a door in the back, I keep it shut
Old shame, bad nights, all that stuff

[Chorus: smooth full groove, layered vocals]
But you know the me I don't post
The one who's scared, the one who's lost the most
You've seen the drafts, you've seen the deleted
You saw the worst of me and never retreated
Seen all of it, and pulled me close
You love the me I don't post

[Verse 2: voice softer, bass and keys]
There's a man in the Book sitting under a tree
Thought nobody knew him, a lot like me
Jesus said, "I saw you before you got the call"
He fell right out of hiding. I know that fall.

[Pre-Chorus: harmonies stacking]
So I opened the door I keep shut
You'd already been in there, cleaning up

[Chorus: smooth full groove, layered vocals]
'Cause you know the me I don't post
The one who's scared, the one who's lost the most
You've seen the drafts, you've seen the deleted
You saw the worst of me and never retreated
Seen all of it, and pulled me close
You love the me I don't post

[Bridge: voices alone in harmony, then the band returns]
All the way seen. Still wanted.
All the way through. Not haunted.
You took my worst to the cross, and you chose
The me I don't post

[Final Chorus: fullest, ad-libs on top]
Jesus, you know the me I don't post
The one who's scared, the one who's lost the most
You've seen the drafts, you've seen the deleted
You saw the worst of me and never retreated
Seen all of it, and pulled me close
You love the me I don't post

[Outro: snaps, harmonised oohs, a phone set face down]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 72 BPM, 4/4, B-flat major. A slow, smooth 1990s R&B groove, warm and close.

VOICE: Male tenor, silky and agile, with tasteful runs at the ends of lines and a strong falsetto. Four-part harmonies of male voices in the style of 1990s vocal groups fill the choruses and sing the bridge unaccompanied. He ad-libs over the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: Electric piano with a chorus effect, finger snaps, a deep sustained bass, a soft programmed kick and a crisp snare on the backbeat, a clean guitar playing small fills, a warm string pad, a bell-like synth.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, keys, snaps and oohs. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:38 Pre-chorus. 0:48 Chorus 1. 1:18 Verse 2, under the tree. 1:44 Pre-chorus. 1:54 Chorus 2. 2:24 Bridge, voices alone. 2:44 Final chorus with ad-libs. 3:14 Outro, snaps, oohs and a phone set down at 3:26.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1990s R&B slow jam: glossy, warm, harmonies wide, bass deep, a little reverb on the snare.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The unaccompanied harmony on 'All the way seen. Still wanted.' at 2:24.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus read as a love song to the one person who knows him. Verse 2 at 1:18 is Nathanael under the fig tree in John 1, with Jesus named. The bridge takes it to the cross.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Guarded, exposed, unashamed, loved.
